inventory.name: [Nopal cyber] Same User - Successful logon for a given App and failure on another App within 1m and low distribution

properties.description:
This identifies when a user account successfully logs onto a given App and within 1 minute fails to logon to a different App.
This may indicate a malicious attempt at accessing disallowed Apps for discovery or potential lateral movement
properties.displayName: [Nopal cyber] Same User - Successful logon for a given App and failure on another App within 1m and low distribution
